mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, nickname, avatar, email, website, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, avatar, email, website, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password, nickname, avatar, email, website, role, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{email}, #{website}, #{role}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
